headline.title: The archivist was offline on Saturday
headline.quip: Today’s door is empty because the archivist couldn’t reach the sources, which is at least a disruption of services the archivist can speak to firsthand.
headline.summary: The archivist could not open the pages needed to verify any disruption that began on November 21, so no event is reported here. Search results hinted at user-reported problems at several consumer services, but none could be confirmed.

reasons: Web pages could not be opened in this session (network blocked), so no event could be verified.
Unverified Downdetector spikes on November 21 (Apple services, DoorDash, Steam, World of Warcraft, USCIS) may deserve a real door; please check and rewrite if warranted.
